import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/training_8.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV into a DataFrame
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in correct order
    # Target schema: ['created_at', 'text', 'coordinates', 'hashtags']
    # All source schemas are the same, so just reorder columns if needed
    df = df[['created_at', 'text', 'coordinates', 'hashtags']]
    # Convert all columns to string type except hashtags which should remain as is (list or string)
    # But from examples, hashtags column is a list or empty list, so keep as is.
    # created_at and text and coordinates should be string
    df['created_at'] = df['created_at'].astype(str)
    df['text'] = df['text'].astype(str)
    # coordinates can be NaN or dict-like string, convert to string
    df['coordinates'] = df['coordinates'].astype(str)
    # hashtags column can be list or string representation of list, keep as is (string)
    # No transformation needed here as target examples show [] or list of dicts as string
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_62/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
